hook: Karthika Pournami: queues from *4 am* at Yadagirigutta, Shiva temples packed
hook_b: Karthika Pournami: queues from *4 am* at Yadagirigutta, Shiva temples packed
tldr: Thousands of devotees queued at Shiva temples in Hyderabad and nearby districts on Tuesday for Karthika Pournami, the holiest full moon of Karthika Masam.

beats.what: Keesaragutta Sri Ramalingeswara Swamy Temple and neighbourhood Shivalayams saw an unbroken stream of devotees lighting deepams and doing abhishekams.
beats.why: Karthika Pournami is the holiest full-moon day of the Karthika month.
beats.care: Expect crowds and traffic around Keesaragutta, Vemulawada, Yadagirigutta, Kaleshwaram and the Thousand Pillar Temple today.

causes.label: Holiest full moon of Karthika Masam

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Temple managements added volunteers, barricades and drinking water points for the rush.

facts.t: Pilgrims fanned out to *5 major shrines*: Vemulawada, Yadagirigutta, Kaleshwaram, Thousand Pillar Temple and Keesaragutta.

watch: Temple managements have barricades, volunteers and drinking water in place for the full-day rush.

sources.title: Devotees throng temples to mark Karthika Pournami in Hyderabad

fact: Karthika Pournami queues began at *4 am* at Yadagirigutta as Shiva temples filled
twist: Tuesday is a public holiday for both Guru Nanak Jayanthi and Karthika Pournami, so families set out on day-long temple trips.
